views.name: clinical_gdc_r38_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT "submitter_id" AS submitter_id,
       "case_id" AS case_id,
       "primary_site" AS primary_site,
       "disease_type" AS disease_type,
       "proj__name" AS project_name,
       "proj__project_id" AS project_id,
       "demo__demographic_id" AS demographic_id,
       "demo__gender" AS gender,
       "demo__race" AS race,
       "demo__ethnicity" AS ethnicity,
       "demo__vital_status" AS vital_status,
       "demo__days_to_birth" AS days_to_birth,
       "demo__year_of_birth" AS year_of_birth,
       "demo__age_at_index" AS age_at_index,
       "diag__diagnosis_id" AS diagnosis_id,
       "diag__primary_diagnosis" AS primary_diagnosis,
       "diag__age_at_diagnosis" AS age_at_diagnosis,
       "diag__year_of_diagnosis" AS year_of_diagnosis,
       "diag__days_to_diagnosis" AS days_to_diagnosis,
       "diag__days_to_last_follow_up" AS days_to_last_follow_up,
       "diag__ajcc_pathologic_stage" AS ajcc_pathologic_stage,
       "diag__prior_malignancy" AS prior_malignancy,
       "diag__prior_treatment" AS prior_treatment,
       "diag__morphology" AS morphology,
       "state" AS record_state,
       "created_datetime" AS created_datetime_epoch,
       "updated_datetime" AS updated_datetime_epoch
FROM TCGA.TCGA_VERSIONED.CLINICAL_GDC_R38
views.description: Normalized clinical snapshot from TCGA.TCGA_VERSIONED.CLINICAL_GDC_R38 with canonical aliases for patient identifiers, demographics and key diagnosis/time measures. Use this as the cleaned case-level clinical dimension when joining to sample/file/measurement tables. | Use for: Join clinical attributes to genomic/sample level data by case_id/submitter_id; Cohort selection by demographics or diagnosis attributes (age, gender, race, disease_type); Time-to-event or follow-up calculations using days_to_* fields after conversion

views.name: clinical_gdc_2018_case_dimension
views.body_sql:
SELECT "case_barcode" AS case_id,
       "program_name" AS program_name,
       "project_short_name" AS project_short_name,
       "project_name" AS project_name,
       "disease_code" AS disease_code,
       "gender" AS gender,
       "vital_status" AS vital_status,
       "race" AS race,
       "ethnicity" AS ethnicity,
       "age_at_diagnosis" AS age_at_diagnosis,
       "days_to_birth" AS days_to_birth,
       "days_to_death" AS days_to_death,
       "days_to_initial_pathologic_diagnosis" AS days_to_initial_pathologic_diagnosis,
       "days_to_last_followup" AS days_to_last_follow_up,
       "clinical_stage" AS clinical_stage,
       "pathologic_stage" AS pathologic_stage,
       "tumor_tissue_site" AS tumor_tissue_site,
       "primary_therapy_outcome_success" AS primary_therapy_outcome_success,
       "histological_type" AS histological_type,
       "neoplasm_histologic_grade" AS neoplasm_histologic_grade,
       "number_of_lymphnodes_examined" AS number_of_lymphnodes_examined,
       "number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he" AS number_of_lymphnodes_positive_by_he,
       "bmi" AS bmi,
       "height" AS height,
       "weight" AS weight
FROM TCGA.TCGA_VERSIONED.CLINICAL_GDC_2018_06
views.description: Normalized case-level clinical snapshot from TCGA.TCGA_VERSIONED.CLINICAL_GDC_2018_06 with canonical column aliases (case_barcode as case_id) and common clinical measures. Useful when source questions reference the older GDC_2018 table naming/fields. | Use for: Case-level demographic and clinical summaries using the 2018_GDC snapshot; Comparing/merging older GDC clinical snapshots with newer clinical tables; Cohort filters by clinical_stage/pathologic_stage or tumor tissue site

views.name: copy_number_gene_level_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT "project_short_name" AS project_short_name,
       "case_barcode" AS case_barcode,
       "case_gdc_id" AS case_gdc_id,
       "sample_barcode" AS sample_barcode,
       "sample_gdc_id" AS sample_gdc_id,
       "aliquot_barcode" AS aliquot_barcode,
       "aliquot_gdc_id" AS aliquot_gdc_id,
       "Ensembl_gene_id" AS ensembl_gene_id,
       "Ensembl_gene_id_v" AS ensembl_gene_id_v,
       "gene_name" AS gene_name,
       "gene_type" AS gene_type,
       "chromosome" AS chromosome,
       "start_pos" AS start_pos,
       "end_pos" AS end_pos,
       "copy_number" AS copy_number,
       "min_copy_number" AS min_copy_number,
       "max_copy_number" AS max_copy_number,
       "file_gdc_id" AS file_gdc_id
FROM TCGA.TCGA_VERSIONED.COPY_NUMBER_GENE_LEVEL_HG38_GDC_R36
views.description: Cleaned gene-level copy number measurements from TCGA.TCGA_VERSIONED.COPY_NUMBER_GENE_LEVEL_HG38_GDC_R36. Exposes sample/case identifiers, gene identifiers and numeric copy-number measures. Use when aggregating copy-number by case/sample or joining to clinical data. | Use for: Per-gene copy-number comparisons across cases or groups; Aggregate sample-level copy-number burden or frequency of gains/losses; Join gene-level copy-number to clinical case attributes by case_barcode/case_gdc_id

views.name: per_sample_file_metadata_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT "file_gdc_id" AS file_gdc_id,
       "case_gdc_id" AS case_gdc_id,
       "case_barcode" AS case_barcode,
       "sample_gdc_id" AS sample_gdc_id,
       "sample_barcode" AS sample_barcode,
       "project_short_name" AS project_short_name,
       "disease_code" AS disease_code,
       "program_name" AS program_name,
       "data_type" AS data_type,
       "data_category" AS data_category,
       "experimental_strategy" AS experimental_strategy,
       "type" AS file_type,
       "file_size" AS file_size,
       "data_format" AS data_format,
       "platform" AS platform,
       "file_name_key" AS file_name_key,
       "access" AS access,
       "acl" AS acl
FROM TCGA.TCGA_VERSIONED.PER_SAMPLE_FILE_METADATA_HG19_GDC_R14
views.description: Canonical per-sample/file metadata projection from TCGA.TCGA_VERSIONED.PER_SAMPLE_FILE_METADATA_HG19_GDC_R14 (and compatible with other PER_SAMPLE_FILE_METADATA_* tables). Provides file identifiers and linking keys useful for selecting files by data_type, data_category, platform, or access control. | Use for: Find files by data_type/platform/access to join to measurement tables; Summarize file counts/size by project or disease_code; Link file-level metadata to case/sample clinical attributes

views.name: clinical_diagnoses_treatments_by_case
views.body_sql:
SELECT "case_id" AS case_id,
       "diag__diagnosis_id" AS diagnosis_id,
       COUNT(*) AS treatment_record_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT "diag__treat__treatment_id") AS distinct_treatment_ids,
       MIN("diag__treat__created_datetime") AS first_treatment_created_datetime,
       MAX("diag__treat__updated_datetime") AS last_treatment_updated_datetime
FROM TCGA.TCGA_VERSIONED.CLINICAL_DIAGNOSES_TREATMENTS_GDC_R24
GROUP BY "case_id","diag__diagnosis_id"
views.description: Aggregated treatment counts per case from TCGA.TCGA_VERSIONED.CLINICAL_DIAGNOSES_TREATMENTS_GDC_R24. Produces counts of treatment records and preserves case/diagnosis linkage for downstream joins. | Use for: Count treatments per case or diagnosis; Identify cases with multiple treatment updates or timeline coverage; Filter cases by presence/absence of treatments when joining to clinical tables

views.name: top_genes_by_copy_number_per_sample_rank
views.body_sql:
SELECT project_short_name,
       case_barcode,
       sample_barcode,
       aliquot_barcode,
       ensembl_gene_id,
       gene_name,
       copy_number,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sample_barcode ORDER BY ABS(copy_number) DESC NULLS LAST) AS gene_rank
FROM (
  SELECT "project_short_name" AS project_short_name,
         "case_barcode" AS case_barcode,
         "sample_barcode" AS sample_barcode,
         "aliquot_barcode" AS aliquot_barcode,
         "Ensembl_gene_id" AS ensembl_gene_id,
         "gene_name" AS gene_name,
         "copy_number" AS copy_number
  FROM TCGA.TCGA_VERSIONED.COPY_NUMBER_GENE_LEVEL_HG38_GDC_R36
) t
views.description: Per-sample ranking of genes by absolute copy_number value (descending) from the COPY_NUMBER_GENE_LEVEL table. Exposes gene_rank which downstream queries can filter (e.g., WHERE gene_rank <= K) to implement Top-K selection without hardcoding K here. | Use for: Select top-N genes by copy-number magnitude per sample; Downstream aggregation of top-altered genes across cohorts; Identify highest-amplitude copy-number events per sample
